stories.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded for discoveries behind optogenetics
stories.reason: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel were honored for turning a light-sensitive algal protein into a tool that can switch individual nerve cells on or off in living brains, a technique now central to neuroscience research worldwide.

stories.title: Spain's Sanchez calls a snap election for November 29 after his housing decrees are voted down
stories.reason: Congress's rejection of measures meant to restrict evictions and rein in investment funds, following weeks of nationwide housing protests, leaves Sanchez facing voters while his Socialist Party trails in the polls.

stories.title: Schneider Electric agrees to buy industrial software firm PTC for $22.6 billion
stories.reason: The all-cash deal, Schneider's largest ever, pays a 42% premium for PTC and aims to fuse industrial design and control software with AI, as the French conglomerate races to capture the same industrial-AI wave reshaping its rivals.

stories.title: Foxconn's quarterly revenue jumps 47% to a record on surging AI server demand
stories.reason: Revenue hit $95.4 billion, well above estimates, with September alone crossing T$1 trillion for the first time as Nvidia's largest server assembler said it expects AI server rack shipments to more than double for the full year.

stories.title: OpenAI starts testing visual ads inside ChatGPT's image generator
stories.reason: The labeled ads will target free users among ChatGPT's 1.2 billion weekly users starting this month in the US, marking OpenAI's clearest move yet toward advertising revenue to offset its enormous computing costs.

stories.title: China's top AI models close the performance gap with the US to a record-low 3%
stories.reason: DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash scored within striking distance of Anthropic's leading model on LiveBench, down from a 15% gap earlier this year, even as Chinese labs' price wars are expected to delay industry profitability until at least 2030.

stories.title: Huawei and Qualcomm sign a multi-year patent deal covering 5G, AI and computing
stories.reason: The agreement marks the first time Qualcomm has agreed to pay for Huawei's patents, a reversal from their historical rivalry, with Huawei saying it will push the total value of its licensing deals past $6.9 billion.

stories.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guard warns it will strike US bases and warships if a ground invasion begins
stories.reason: IRGC adviser Ali Fadavi's warning comes as the US continues massing carrier and amphibious forces in the region, underscoring how a ground invasion remains the clearest redline in the ongoing standoff.
